# Aim

This analysis joins gender inequality data to world country boundaries
and calculates the change between 2010 and 2019.

#Load packages

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
```



```{r}
gid <- read_csv("week4data/gender_inequality.csv") %>%
  clean_names()

world <- st_read("week4data/world.geojson") %>%
  clean_names()
```
```{r}
gid_selected <- gid %>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019) |> 
  mutate(
    gii_2010 = as.numeric(gii_2010),
    gii_2019 = as.numeric(gii_2019)
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(iso3))
  
```


```{r}
world <- world %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = countrycode(
      country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
      
    )
  )
```
```{r}
world |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  filter(is.na(iso3)) |> 
  select(country)
  
```
```{r}
world_gii <- merge(
  world,
  gid_selected,
  by = "iso3",
  all.x = TRUE
)
```




```{r}
world_gii <- world_gii |> 
  mutate(
    gii_change = gii_2019 - gii_2010
  )

```

```{r}
summary(world_gii$gii_change)
sum(!is.na(world_gii$gii_change))
```

```{r}
world_gii |> 
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  filter(iso3 == "AZE") |> 
  select(iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019, gii_change)
  
```


```{r}
plot(
  world_gii["gii_change"],
  main = "Gender Inequality Index Change, 2010-2019"
)
```
